lines.en: I crawl along the leaf vein.

lines.zh: 我的身体一弓一伸，往前挪
lines.en: My body arches and stretches forward.

lines.zh: 我爬过的叶子被啃出锯齿边
lines.en: The leaves I cross are left with serrated edges.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，嘴一直没停
lines.en: I move slowly, my mouth never idle.

lines.zh: 我爬到叶子边缘，便退了回来
lines.en: I crawl to the leaf's edge and back away.
I am nearly finished with this leaf.

lines.zh: 我挪到新叶上，脚有黏性
lines.en: I move to a fresh leaf; my feet stick.
I chew as I crawl.

lines.zh: 我沿着枝条走向下一片叶
lines.en: I walk the branch to the next leaf.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢光，我总在叶背
lines.en: I dislike light; I stay on leaf undersides.

lines.zh: 我的身体是青绿色的，有纹
lines.en: My body is green with stripes.

lines.zh: 我绕了半圈，找到一处嫩的
lines.en: I circle halfway and find a tender spot.

lines.zh: 我抬起身子，摸了摸前面
lines.en: I lift my front and feel the way.

lines.zh: 我每走一段就留下一道缺口
lines.en: Each stretch I cross leaves a notch.
Off the leaves, I die.

lines.zh: 我爬到叶柄那里，试了试
lines.en: I reach the leaf stem and test it.
I lie in the leaf's middle, body plump.
My mouth moves, always chewing.

lines.zh: 我把头抬起来，看看上面
lines.en: I raise my head to look up.

lines.zh: 叶子的汁水从我嘴边流下来
lines.en: Leaf juice runs down from my mouth.
I cannot walk far.
I listen to the tree.

lines.zh: 我在这里很安全，绿得看不清
lines.en: I am safe here; my green hides me.
I am a little hungrier.
I shrink back from the wind.
My skin carries stripes.
This leaf will feed me for a while.

lines.zh: 我不需要跑，也没有敌人会追我
lines.en: I need not run; nothing chases me.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，离你的脸很近
lines.en: I raise my head, close to your face.

lines.zh: 你不要碰叶子，我就不会掉
lines.en: Do not touch the leaf and I will not fall.

lines.zh: 我认得你的手，刚才托过我
lines.en: I know your hand; it carried me.
My mouth is still full of leaf.
You are looking at my stripes.
I will become a very large moth.
Do not put me on the ground.

lines.zh: 你手上那块叶子，我能吃
lines.en: That leaf in your hand, I could eat.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，装成一段茎
lines.en: I stay still, pretending to be a stem.

lines.zh: 我的身体被压扁了一块
lines.en: Part of my body is squashed.
That left me unable to crawl.
I curl up slowly.
A length of my stripes is broken.
Don't squeeze me; all I do is chew leaves.

lines.zh: 我从叶背掉下去了，摔得发晕。
lines.en: I fell off the underside of the leaf, and my head is spinning.
It hurts... every bristle on me is standing up.

lines.zh: 这一下，比离开树叶还难受。
lines.en: That hurt worse than being taken off my leaf.
Is that a leaf? Is it for me?

lines.zh: 我朝它爬过去，爬得很急
lines.en: I crawl toward it, quickly.
This leaf is tender; I like it.

lines.zh: 我先闻了闻，才咬第一口
lines.en: I sniff first, then take the first bite.
That much in your hand is enough.
I eat noisily.
This tastes sweet.

lines.zh: 我顺着你的手爬上去了
lines.en: I climb up onto your hand.

lines.zh: 你放下的叶子，我一会儿就到
lines.en: I will reach the leaf you set down shortly.

lines.zh: 你碰了一下，我缩成一团
lines.en: You touched me and I curled up.

lines.zh: 我被撞得滚下了一片叶
lines.en: The bump rolled me off a leaf.

lines.zh: 这一下不疼，只是吓到我了
lines.en: That did not hurt, only startled me.
I grip the leaf.
I cannot push back.

lines.zh: 我们碰到了，我贴在你手上
lines.en: We touched; I am stuck to your hand.
My juices are on you now.
I crawl slowly back to the underside.
The leaf swayed.
Do not touch again.
I am young, only a caterpillar.

lines.zh: 这件事要等我长出翅膀
lines.en: That must wait until I grow wings.
Right now I only think about eating.

lines.zh: 将来会有那么一只，飞过来
lines.en: Someday one will come flying.
I wait on the underside of a leaf.

lines.zh: 我们两个一起啃，会更快
lines.en: The two of us eating together would go faster.

lines.zh: 我把自己裹起来之前，不会想这些
lines.en: Until I wrap myself up, I will not think of it.
This leaf is enough for two.
I can smell my kind on this tree.
When the time comes, I will know.
You cup me in your palm; it is warm.
Do not squeeze; I would be crushed.

lines.zh: 你要把我放到别的叶子上吗
lines.en: Are you moving me to another leaf?
I grip your finger.
The leaf is where I belong.

lines.zh: 这里太干，我撑不了多久
lines.en: This is too dry; I will not last long.
I lift my front to find a direction.
That leaf is good; put me there.
Away from the leaves I panic.
Thank you for moving me.
There is a tender leaf over there.
I smell leaves.
I raise my head toward the light.
I can crawl that way.
I would rather eat, nothing else.
The leaf is there; I must get to it.
I am finding where to put my next foot.
The tree is windy; I must hold on.

lines.zh: 我离那片叶只有一截枝
lines.en: One branch length from that leaf.

lines.zh: 嫩叶的边卷着，正合我啃。
lines.en: That tender leaf curls at the edge, just right to nibble.
I have been crawling without pause.
This leaf is nearly gone.
I keep to the same branch.

lines.zh: 我不看别的，我只看叶子
lines.en: I look at nothing but leaves.

lines.zh: 你在我下面，我够不到你
lines.en: You are below; I cannot reach you.
I chew faster than I walk.

lines.zh: 前面那片叶子的边已经旧了
lines.en: That leaf ahead has an old edge.
I am tired, but I must keep eating.

lines.zh: 如果我停下，我就长不大
lines.en: If I stop, I will not grow.
I keep moving forward.
I have no way to attack anyone.
Touch me and I can only curl.
I bite leaves, not you.

lines.zh: 我抬起身子，只是吓了一跳
lines.en: I rear up, only startled.
I have no spines.
All I can do is hold on.
If I fall to the ground, I am finished.
I curl smaller.
This leaf is not enough cover.
I crawl slowly back.
I hatched from an egg.
The first thing I did was find a leaf.

lines.zh: 森林里叶子多，我留在这里
lines.en: Plenty of leaves in this forest; I stay.

lines.zh: 我在叶背待了一整个早上
lines.en: I spent the whole morning on a leaf's underside.
I am still damp.
I crawl down the branch.
I ate this leaf first.
I am too small for anyone to notice.
I have slowly begun to eat.
There are many of my kind in this tree.

lines.zh: 火一靠近，我的身体就缩了
lines.en: Fire comes close and my body shrinks.

lines.zh: 我从叶上掉到地上，摔得很重
lines.en: I fall from the leaf to the ground, hard.

lines.zh: 水淹过我，我浮起来又沉下去
lines.en: Water covers me; I float, then sink.
The blast flings me off the leaf.

lines.zh: 有东西扎穿了我的身体
lines.en: Something pierces my body.

lines.zh: 一股温热穿过我，我抖了一下
lines.en: A warmth passes through me and I twitch.
Without leaves I cannot last.

lines.zh: 雷光太亮，我整个缩进叶心
lines.en: The flash is too bright; I shrink into the leaf's middle.

lines.zh: 叶子没有了，我一直往下掉
lines.en: The leaf is gone; I keep falling.
